answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond before it can bid on work, and slash that bond when peers catch it colluding. One honest agent posts a single deposit and earns it back with interest as its record grows terrace by terrace. A sybil farm must fund every clone, and once one is caught, the slashing ripples like a pulse through all linked bonds, so the fraud shatters like thin crystal and the attack costs far more than it pays.
